metadata.title: Gritty 80s Portrait with Distressed Slab Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a man in a leather jacket, characterized by a high-contrast black and white subject against a warm, textured background. The composition is anchored by massive, distressed slab-serif lettering that spans the top edge, partially obscured by the subject's head.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject head overlapping the base of the typography
High-contrast black leather against a neutral, grainy background
Distressed texture of the type mirroring the film grain of the photo
Warm orange-tan accents contrasting with cool grayscale skin tones
coreInvariants: Heavy halftone or film grain texture across the entire image
Muted, desaturated color palette with one primary accent color
Slab-serif typography with irregular, eroded edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, waist-up portrait; the head occupies the vertical center, breaking into the typographic space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark mass of the leather jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large-scale text at the top, down to the subject's face, following the lines of the jacket collar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with a consistent grain and the large-scale header text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated gray and off-white for the subject and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the leather jacket and hair shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange-tan for the header typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the subject's clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to grayscale and one earthy accent tone

letterConstructionRules: Eroded, 'stamped' texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical compression to fit the top margin
Irregular edge distressing to simulate old print
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface; no secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic slab serif with appropriate proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a black leather jacket against a grainy, off-white background. Apply a heavy film grain and halftone texture. Leave the top 20% of the frame clear for text, but allow the hair to overlap slightly into that area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of massive, uppercase slab-serif text across the top. Use a muted orange-tan color. Apply a heavy 'grunge' or 'distressed' texture to the letters so they look like a worn screen print. Ensure the subject's hair appears to be in front of the bottom edge of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a muted orange-tan?
Does the subject's hair overlap the text?
Is the overall texture grainy and high-contrast?
Is the font a heavy slab-serif?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the typography
Specific hue of the accent color
mustRedesign: Do not use specific celebrity likenesses
Do not use existing brand logos
Do not use exact trademarked font files

mustAchieve: Balanced overlap between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent grain across text and image
Ensure the slab serifs are thick and blocky
Verify the 'behind-the-head' placement of the text
Confirm the color palette is restricted to grayscale and tan
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W portrait with a single-color, massive, distressed slab-serif header that sits behind the subject's crown.
